starting_state: Channel 1 sends to the emulator test device and plays pattern 1: four trigs on steps 1-4 (C, D, E, F = MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65; velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) in the default C major scale. No masks are set.

steps.caption: Starting point: channel 1 plays pattern 1 on steps 1-4 with the notes C, D, E and F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) and no masks are set. Turn E1 to Channel tasks, turn E2 to Masks and press K3, then turn E2 to Chd1. The four chord rows Chd1-Chd4 add voices above each step's root, and X means no voice.

With no step held, turn E3 right until the screen reads 3rd (two detents). Every step now plays its root and the scale third above it: 60+64, 62+65, 64+67, 65+69. Chord values are scale intervals, not MIDI numbers. Read the MIDI strip: each step sends its root and its chord note together.

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop

steps.caption: Hold step 1 (grid (1,4)) and turn E3 right until the screen reads 5th (two more detents). Step 1 now plays 60 and 67; the screen shows 5th while the step is held.

Release step 1. The screen shows the channel default 3rd again, but step 1 keeps its own fifth: the phrase is 60+67, then 62+65, 64+67, 65+69. Read the MIDI strip: step 1 sends 60 and 67 together, the other steps their roots and thirds.

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop

steps.caption: Hold step 1, press K2 and release the step. The fifth is cleared and step 1 returns to the channel third: 60+64, then 62+65, 64+67, 65+69.

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop
